title: Content Writer Intern
description:
Content Writer Intern – Fresher

**Location:** Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Experience:** Fresher

About Lime Tea

Lime Tea is a digital marketing agency serving brands across India and the GCC markets. We work with businesses across diverse industries to build creative and performance\-driven digital marketing strategies.

Our services include SEO, Social Media Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content Marketing, Web Development, Branding, Graphic Design, and Video Production.

We are looking for a **creative and enthusiastic Content Writer Intern** who is passionate about writing and interested in learning how content is created for different brands, platforms, and audiences.

**Freshers are welcome to apply. No prior professional experience is required.**

Key Responsibilities

* Create engaging and original content for different client accounts.
* Write social media captions, post content, reel scripts, blogs, website content, and advertisements.
* Develop creative hooks, taglines, ideas, and campaign copy.
* Assist in creating SEO\-friendly blogs, articles, website content, and landing page copy.
* Conduct basic research on topics, industries, competitors, and target audiences.
* Adapt writing style and tone according to different brands and audiences.
* Proofread and edit content for grammar, clarity, and consistency.
* Create content based on creative briefs and client requirements.
* Stay updated with social media trends, content formats, and digital marketing trends.
* Learn to use AI content tools for research and ideation while maintaining originality and brand voice.
* Manage assigned content tasks and complete them within deadlines.

Requirements

* **Freshers only.**
* Strong interest in writing, content creation, social media, and digital marketing.
* Good written communication skills with strong grammar and vocabulary.
* Ability to write clearly and creatively.
* Good research and storytelling skills.
* Basic understanding of social media platforms.
* Basic knowledge of SEO is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Willingness to learn new content formats, tools, and digital marketing concepts.
* Ability to adapt writing style according to different brands and audiences.
* Good attention to detail.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Basic knowledge of AI content tools is an advantage.
* A degree or relevant educational background in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

What You Will Learn

As a Content Writer Intern at Lime Tea, you will get hands\-on exposure to:

* Social media content writing
* Creative copywriting
* Reel scripts and content hooks
* Blog and article writing
* SEO content writing
* Keyword research
* Website and landing page content
* Advertising and campaign copy
* Content research and competitor analysis
* AI\-assisted content research and ideation
* Working with SEO, social media, performance marketing, design, and development teams

Why Join Lime Tea?

* Work on real projects for brands across India and GCC markets.
* Gain practical experience in a professional digital marketing agency.
* Get exposure to multiple industries and different content styles.
* Learn from SEO, social media, performance marketing, design, and development teams.
* Develop both creative and digital marketing skills.
* Work in a collaborative in\-house environment.
* Opportunity for professional growth and skill development.

Job Details

**Position:** Content Writer Intern  
**Experience:** Fresher  
**Location:** Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

How to Apply

Interested freshers can apply through Indeed with their updated resume. but **previous professional experience is not required**.

Pay: From ₹5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

#### **Infopark, Kochi**


### **Technical Content Writer**

* Edit, proofread, and optimize content to ensure accuracy, consistency, readability, and adherence to brand guidelines.

* Write captions, taglines, campaign messages, and promotional copy for digital marketing campaigns.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather information and support business and marketing initiatives.
* Monitor content performance and suggest improvements based on analytics and engagement metrics.

### **Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of experience in Technical Content Writing, SEO Content Writing, or Digital Content Marketing.
* Strong understanding of IT services, SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and emerging technologies.
* Awareness of global IT markets and evolving technology landscapes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of SEO, keyword research, and content performance metrics.
* Familiarity with CMS platforms, AI writing tools, and digital marketing tools.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into engaging content for different audiences.
* Strong research, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.


To apply for this position, please send your resume to \[email protected]. Be sure to include the job title in the subject line.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
**SEO Content Writer**

**Company:** SpiderWorks Technologies  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About SpiderWorks Technologies**

SpiderWorks Technologies is a leading digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, social media marketing, web development, branding, and performance marketing. We help businesses strengthen their digital presence through innovative strategies and impactful campaigns.

**About the Role**

SpiderWorks Technologies is looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **SEO Content Writer** to produce high\-quality, engaging, and search\-engine\-optimized content for websites, blogs, and digital marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate should have excellent English writing skills, a good understanding of SEO, and the ability to create content that is both user\-focused and optimized for search engines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and write SEO\-friendly content for websites, blogs, landing pages, and other digital platforms.
* Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant keywords naturally into content.
* Create engaging, informative, and original content based on assigned topics and target audiences.
* Optimize existing content for better search visibility and user engagement.
* Write SEO titles, meta descriptions, headings, and other on\-page content elements.
* Conduct competitor and topic research to identify relevant content opportunities.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure proper grammar, readability, accuracy, and consistency.
* Coordinate with SEO and digital marketing teams to meet content requirements.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field**.
* 1–3 years of experience in SEO content writing or a related field.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience in SEO content writing or digital marketing.
* Familiarity with tools such as **Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Ubersuggest, or Google Keyword Planner**.
* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms.
* Basic understanding of AI\-assisted content tools and the ability to fact\-check and humanize AI\-generated content.
* Knowledge of current SEO and content marketing practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong knowledge of grammar, sentence structure, and content formatting.
* Basic to good understanding of **SEO and content marketing**.
* Knowledge of keyword research, search intent, on\-page SEO, internal linking, and content optimization.
* Ability to conduct online research and gather information from reliable sources.
* Strong attention to detail and proofreading skills.
* Ability to write content for different industries and target audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple content assignments and meet deadlines.

Interested candidates can apply by submitting their updated resume, portfolio and relevant writing samples or published articles that demonstrate their research and content writing.

title: Social Media Intern & Content Writer
description:
We're Hiring: Social Media \& Content Writer (Intern / 2–3 Years Experience)

**SwarmLens** is looking for strong writers to help shape how we talk about AI, technology, and business across LinkedIn, blogs, and our broader content presence. We're hiring for two tracks: an internship for those starting out, and a role for candidates with some hands\-on experience.

If you can research a topic, find the story in it, and write it in a way that's clear and engaging, we'd like to hear from you.

Who can apply

* Interns / Freshers — strong writing ability, no prior experience required
* 2–3 years experienced — candidates with relevant content/social media writing experience

What we're looking for

* Strong creative and article\-writing skills, with excellent written English
* Ability to simplify technical and AI topics into content that's easy to follow
* Background in Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Media Studies, Marketing, or a related field (preferred, not mandatory)
* Working understanding of social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn
* Writing samples or a portfolio — mandatory for both tracks

What you'll work on

* Articles and blogs
* LinkedIn and social media content
* AI and technology\-related writing
* Industry research and thought\-leadership pieces
* Creative content ideas and campaigns
* Building out **SwarmLens**' digital presence

Location: Kochi / Remote

About **SwarmLens**  
**SwarmLens** is an AI\-focused technology company building domain\-specific AI solutions for enterprise customers, working at the intersection of AI, data, industry expertise, and business applications.

To apply  
Send your CV along with writing samples/portfolio to **garima.singh@swarmlens.com**  
Subject line: Application – Social Media \& Content Writer (Intern) or Application – Social Media \& Content Writer (Experienced) depending on which track fits you.

Applications without writing samples won't be considered.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
